Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.schema

Class ForeignIdColumnDefinition

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.schema.ColumnDefinition
org.aristonis.diwan.database.schema.ForeignIdColumnDefinition
public final class ForeignIdColumnDefinition extends ColumnDefinition
The column BlueprintKeys.foreignId(String), BlueprintHelpers.foreignUuid(String) or BlueprintHelpers.foreignUlid(String) adds: a key column that can point at another table's key in one call, table.foreignId("user_id").constrained().

Every modifier returns this type, so constrained() can come after them: table.foreignId("user_id").nullable().constrained().nullOnDelete().

  • Method Details

    • constrained

      public ForeignKeyDefinition constrained()
      Adds a foreign key to the id column of the table the column name points at, as Laravel does: user_id references users, blog_category_id blog_categories. A column added by Blueprint.foreignIdFor(ForeignKeySource) points at the table and key of its source instead.
      Returns:
      the foreign key, for its actions, never null
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the blueprint can no longer be changed
      API Note:
      The plural is guessed with English rules and a short list of irregular nouns; name the table with constrained(String) when the guess is wrong.

    • constrained

      public ForeignKeyDefinition constrained(String table)
      Adds a foreign key to the id column of a named table; for a column added by Blueprint.foreignIdFor(ForeignKeySource), to the key column of its source.
      Parameters:

      Returns:
      the foreign key, for its actions, never null
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if table is null

      IllegalStateException - if the blueprint can no longer be changed
